lines.label: What it holds

source.publisher: National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control

lines.value: Nigeria's searchable database of products registered by NAFDAC.

lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control

lines.value: Applicants submit registration documents through NAFDAC's e-registration portal, and drug applications pass document verification, facility inspection and sampling, laboratory analysis and final vetting before an approval meeting issues a NAFDAC registration number.

lines.label: Scheme

source.publisher: National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control

lines.value: GS1 unique identifier in a GS1 data matrix under the Pharmaceutical Products (Traceability) Regulations 2024

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control

lines.value: Primary and secondary packs carry a unique identifier of GTIN, batch or lot number, expiry date and serial number encoded in a GS1 data matrix; tertiary packs carry GTIN, batch and expiry in a GS1 data matrix or GS1-128; GTIN plus serial must be unique and follow GS1 General Specifications.
